main.summary: Internal owner for one named Tool service scope.
main.remarks: Tracks the underlying scope instance, handle reference count, and disposal for one Tool-owned named scope.

field.name: remove
field.summary: Registry callback used to remove this named scope by name and owner identity before final disposal work begins.

field.name: scope
field.summary: Underlying async service scope owned by this named Tool service scope.

field.name: sync
field.summary: Synchronization lock that guards reference-count and state transitions.

field.name: refcount
field.summary: Number of active public Tool service scope handles currently acquired.

field.name: disposing
field.summary: True once this named Tool service scope has retired from acquisition and entered disposal.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Create a new named Tool service scope owner.
constructor.param: True when this is the reserved default Tool service scope.
constructor.returns: New named Tool service scope owner.

property.name: IsDefault
property.summary: True when this named Tool service scope is the reserved default scope.
property.returns: True if this is the default Tool service scope.

property.name: Name
property.summary: Name of the Tool service scope.

property.name: ServiceProvider
property.summary: Scoped service provider owned by this named Tool service scope.

method.name: Acquire
method.summary: Acquire a new public handle for this named Tool service scope.
method.returns: Public Tool service scope handle, or null when acquisition is no longer allowed.

method.name: Release
method.summary: Release one handle reference synchronously, disposing a non-default named scope when its final handle is released.

method.name: ReleaseAsync
method.summary: Release one handle reference asynchronously, disposing a non-default named scope when its final handle is released.
method.returns: A ValueTask that represents the asynchronous release operation.

method.name: Dispose
method.summary: Dispose the named Tool service scope synchronously.

method.name: DisposeAsync
method.summary: Dispose the named Tool service scope asynchronously.
method.returns: A ValueTask that represents the asynchronous disposal operation.

method.name: DisposeCore
method.summary: Dispose the underlying async service scope synchronously.
method.remarks: Called only after disposal ownership has been claimed by the named scope state machine.

method.name: DisposeAsyncCore
method.summary: Dispose the underlying async service scope asynchronously.
method.remarks: Called only after disposal ownership has been claimed by the named scope state machine.
method.returns: A ValueTask that represents the underlying scope disposal operation.
